nominee.longerDescription: Happy Woman Crush Wednesday! Today I have a Twitch streamer I do not follow, but I've seen her a lot on Instagram recently. As you probably guessed, she's into Minecraft, but it seems like she's open to a lot of games. Another thing she's open to, is vehicles, as she drives a Z4 (not sure where that Porsche came from, but I had to include it for you), and has not one, but two (!) bikes, cause apart from the Alex-specced GSX-R pictured above, she also has a Honda CBR500R! Obviously the bike stuff doesn't really excite me (neither the car stuff tbh), but I wanted to mention it cause I knew you would appreciate it

comments.name: Eszu
comments.text: OH WOW! Honestly her interests are a dream combo. Also I love the Porsche feature it moved me a lot 😭
